search_scope: four sequential energy/regeneration candidates; not exhaustive

candidates.proposed_role: Finite proton/electron reservoir and catalytic interface

conditions.carbon_boundary: oxide carbon-free; glassy carbon/Nafion electrode is not

candidates.observation: Source monohydrate x≈0.69 in measured window and CA-interpolated HER overpotential 501.0 mV at 10 mA cm−2.
candidates.failure: No shared-medium target compatibility or autonomous reservoir recharge; stored hydrogen can enter HER.
candidates.reason: A soluble multi-electron reservoir offers a distinct charge-storage architecture.

conditions.medium: aqueous concentrated lithium salt, concentration-dependent 50–100 mM cases
conditions.pH: low-concentration CV pH 4 and 7 does not define all concentrated experiments

candidates.observation: Up to 18 electrons per cluster under studied conditions; concentrated reduced solutions can release H2 on dilution. Separate UV–vis experiment uses 10 mM and up to 12 electrons.
candidates.executed_check: Source main text and figure captions reread; current hashes in source_ledger.json.
candidates.failure: Finite externally written state with concentration-dependent discharge; no target coupling or retained activity after renewal.
candidates.reason: Evaluate a mediator with both stages of a full externally driven cycle quantified.

conditions.comparison_electrolyte: 1 M H3PO4 in source comparator; not asserted to be mixed with buffer
conditions.potential_reference: NHE values already reported by authors
conditions.carbon_boundary: active anion carbon-free; demonstrated membranes/electrodes include carbon
conditions.benchmark_scope: Author estimate combining separate half-cell comparisons at 100 mA cm−2 with platinum electrodes; not integrated full-cell work.

candidates.observation: Benchmark two-step equivalent voltage 2.94 versus 2.55 V direct; equal two-electron throughput.
candidates.failure: No common-medium Mo36 or target-regeneration measurement. External electrical input is permitted; this demonstrated buffer cycle does not establish its useful coupling to target maintenance.
candidates.reason: Test a distinct energy transduction route using external heat.

conditions.temperature_note: both instruments retained; actual temperature unresolved
conditions.carbon_boundary: CeO2 active phase carbon-free; 2010 separate preparation used carbonaceous poreformers

candidates.observation: Nine published cycle central values transcribed; all incident energy sums checked; corrected total-output/total-input efficiencies 0.0099121%, 0.0114768%, 0.0093518%.
candidates.failure: High-temperature gas-solid cycle has no same aqueous medium or characterized interface with target. Large source uncertainties forbid precise new kinetics.
candidates.reason: Next information gain requires joint identity, charge and functional-turnover measurement; arbitrary additions do not resolve it.

external_energy_policy: External energy is admissible; missing target coupling and maintained function are the failure criteria.
